lines.quote: Implemented the digital beamforming back-end for a 4-element UHF phased-array test bed, writing the steering-vector computation and signal-summation routines in MATLAB and verifying beam patterns against measured data from a rooftop antenna installation.

requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: The beamforming demonstrator describes verifying beam patterns against measured rooftop data, but does not describe RF test-bench equipment (network analyser, spectrum analyser, anechoic chamber) or front-end calibration; classified conservatively as not_stated.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: Degree is in Biomedical Engineering, not electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics; whether it counts as a closely adjacent field is left to the recruiter's judgement.

lines.quote: All project documentation and internal technical reporting at Baltic Sensor Networks is in English.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ running on real hardware under timing constraints?
Can you describe your experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, such as tested and maintained code used by others?
Can you describe any hands-on RF measurement experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber testing?
